decision: Accept as scoped correctness repair with explicitly documented performance cost; not performance-neutral or universal mx parity.
limitations: Common harness and CLI use different prompts, microbatching and decode history; common gains do not cancel CLI loss.
A single layout perturbation does not resolve the slowdown cause.
8B common decode candidate/mx +0.126%, four of eight pairs faster, is effectively tied.
Monitoring covers whole invocations and every invocation retains unknown process CPU deltas.
scope: Independent arithmetic/tradeoff review of retained samples. No additional workload or modified adoption threshold.
